page_title: BOL 2-3 VER | Bologna v Verona 30/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Suat Serdar (Verona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Suat Serdar (Verona) takes it short.
90+2' The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Giovanni Fabbian is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
89' Here comes a substitution. Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Emil Holm.
89' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) replacing Jens Odgaard.
88' 2 - 3 It's an own goal! Santiago Castro (Bologna) unluckily beats his own goalkeeper.
87' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
87' Suat Serdar (Verona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Giovanni Ayroldi who sees an offensive foul.
85' Santiago Castro (Bologna) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
84' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends it out of play.
83' Juan Miranda (Bologna) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
81' Suat Serdar (Verona) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Dominguez leaves the pitch and Dan Ndoye (Bologna) comes on.
80' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
78' Giovanni Ayroldi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Remo Freuler (Bologna).
77' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' It will be a corner kick for Bologna.

76' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
74' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Daniel Mosquera (Verona) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
72' Bologna show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
70' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Casper Tengstedt will be replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
70' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amin Sarr.
68' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Giovanni Ayroldi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Juan Miranda (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
65' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
64' Remo Freuler (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
63' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle after Suat Serdar (Verona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
62' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) sees a yellow card from Giovanni Ayroldi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
62' None of the Bologna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
61' Juan Miranda (Bologna) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
61' A player from Verona commits a rough challenge. Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Bologna will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
59' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Tomas Suslov is replaced by Reda Belahyane (Verona).
59' Substitution. Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) replaces Pawel Dawidowicz.
58' 2 - 2 Goal! Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
57' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Diego Coppola (Verona) for his blatant foul.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
54' Tempers flare after Tomas Suslov (Verona) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
51' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
50' Juan Miranda (Bologna) works the corner short.
49' Tomas Suslov (Verona) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.

48' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Giovanni Ayroldi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Bologna are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
48' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

47' Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a great save to deny Jens Odgaard (Bologna) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' 1 - 2 Goal! Casper Tengstedt (Verona) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Suat Serdar inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
44' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
43' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) and Sam Beukema matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
42' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
41' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
41' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) brought his opponent down.
40' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
38' 1 - 1 Goal! Casper Tengstedt provides Amin Sarr (Verona) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
37' A raking crossfield pass from Emil Holm (Bologna) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
36' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Giovanni Ayroldi no option but to blow his whistle.
36' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a quick execution. A superb strike only denied by the right post.

34' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the right side of the goal, but it lacks power and Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
33' Bologna will take a free kick near the side line.
32' Giovanni Ayroldi interrupts the game. One of the players from Verona won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
30' Paolo Zanetti is forced to make a change. Darko Lazovic is unable to continue due to injury, Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) comes on.

29' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Lorenzo Montipo, who pulls off a stunning save!
28' Bologna are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Santiago Castro (Bologna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Verona will take a throw-in.
26' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Verona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
24' Giovanni Ayroldi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) and blew his whistle.
23' Bologna are seeing far more of the ball now.
21' The corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona) is cleared away by the defence.

20' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Santiago Castro, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna), who beats Lorenzo Montipo with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.

18' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
17' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
17' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Remo Freuler (Bologna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Verona.
14' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) produces a long-range pass.
13' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
11' Bologna are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bologna are taking a throw-in.

10' Verona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
9' Emil Holm (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
8' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
8' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) commits a foul after dangerous play.

6' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bologna.
5' Tomas Suslov (Verona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
3' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
2' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Amin Sarr (Verona) offside.
1' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Giovanni Ayroldi.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
